name: Prison bars door section
description: The door section of the prison bars, 1.5 m long and 2.4 m high: the same grey stone sill and lintel and round iron bars, with two square posts carrying a barred cell door on three strap hinges, a rusted box lock plate with a keyhole and a ring pull, and a barred transom above it. Joins side by side with the bar sections.

provenance.prompt: The matching 1.5 m prison bars section with a barred door and lock plate, about 2.4 m high, joins side by side.
